svg.title: CdTe in the toluene washings
svg.text: Removed fraction · size/shape spread remains source-scoped
Illustrative particles · not a measured size distribution
svg.desc: Illustrative free CdTe specimen identity, not a reconstruction of measured particle geometry. The source discussion distinguishes washed-away particles from the approximately5nm quasi-spherical no-tube comparison; its monodispersity wording does not establish that these are the same sample. No missing comparator recipe or exact polymorph is supplied.
